## Historical PR588 native Real moment, exact source-bound publication

This package publishes seven already accepted Lean sources and retains two public PR585 moment prerequisites. The resulting nine-source closure has 31 complete axiom probes: 20 from the seven fresh public roots and 11 from the two retained roots. All included Lean bytes match the accepted research sources.

The author-checked historical source context is main `9594b61042164a27a31e44d8c3197f231470eda0`, whose conditional selected κ is **400569730495803 / 250000000000000000 = 0.001602278921983212**. This is the source-matched context for the PR588 data proved here.

The intended publication base is current main `5996f9043c27bafa90b23e1c937de92a738f1a76`, subject to the publisher's final main recheck. Its separately author-read conditional selected κ is **16127213726553 / 10000000000000000 = 0.0016127213726553**, from the PR596 selection. The package does not replace its historical PR588 inputs with that newer profile or prove the newer selected endpoint.

The accepted theorem bounds the exact nine-term native expression Σ (r·c)/(73·7168) · exp(b·log(73/r)), at b = 802425169927850686731 / 500000000000000000000000, by the source's single outward-ceiling rational upper. The upper minus one is exactly −696193 / 250000000000000000000000000000, so the finite Real moment is strictly below one. The selected native branch has no fallback summand. Conservative-complex and bit branches retain their own surcharge models and are outside this package.

Four PR588 files provide the rank-30 finite/Real logarithm unit and native rational/Real aggregate. Three unchanged, previously unpublished support files provide generic exponential enclosure, logarithm units, and executable outward rounding. PR585 at `809915a264d4fbe1f7597cc13da3610dc4d52f15` supplies the two retained rational moment modules. Runtime inventory provenance comes from the exact PR526 base, the selected PR573 extension subset, and 158 additional rows, forming the accepted 3,260-module cache.

The isolated public reproduction passed with exactly two retained outputs and seven serial fresh roots. Fresh compiler time totaled 50.832447741 seconds; actual FIFO wait totaled 33.034372293 seconds. Peak VM was 3,095,539,712 bytes. All nine objects match their references, and all 31 complete probes are clean. Five raw logs match byte-for-byte; four logs differ only by 16 explicitly checked source-path substitutions in preserved warning lines. The measured public status and receipt references live in REPLAY_SUMMARY.json. Every root met the existing 60-second/4-GiB hard and 40-second/3.5-GiB review limits.

Bootstrap and outer-parameter/slack proofs are outside this package. Profile/operator and recurrence realization, physical/compiler/hosting/precision/tape suppliers and all-size transfer remain explicit obligations. Neither conditional κ context is asserted here as a full Lean multiplication theorem.

Lean sources, provenance and prose were substantially prepared with OpenAI assistance and independently reviewed at scientific, API and terminal boundaries. Candidate-specific aggregate checks and hosted CI have no new outcome claimed by this draft. The public README and exact manifests contain attribution, immutable dependency pins and the offline retained-prefix command.
